title: potentilla recta subsp. fallacina
intro: Potentilla recta subsp. fallacina, commonly known as the false potentilla or fallacious potentilla, is a subspecies of the Potentilla recta plant, belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla recta subsp. fallacina are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cardiotonic and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
